summary: M.S. Computer Engineering, Rochester Institute of Technology. Build real time computer vision and perception systems on NVIDIA Jetson, optimizing deep learning inference with TensorRT and CUDA for closed loop robotic control. Hands on with camera and depth sensor integration (RGB, ToF), YOLO detection pipelines, and medical image segmentation, backed by production C++/Python and GitLab CI/CD workflows.

experience.title: Research Fellowship
bullets: Engineered a data pipeline for the BraTS 2020 multi modal MRI dataset with medical imaging augmentation and batch loading memory management for large scale 3D volumetric inputs.
Trained U-Net segmentation with VGG-16/19 and ResNet-50 backbones, evaluated on Dice Score and IoU.
Led a cross cultural team of 7 as the sole ML experienced student, restructuring task distribution to deliver the full pipeline within a 6 week window.

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
bullets: Curated a custom object detection dataset and trained YOLOv8n on 1,133 annotated images, achieving 83% mAP@50 on held out validation; exported to ONNX and TFLite for mobile deployment.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Developed a wearable gesture recognition glove integrating ADXL345 accelerometers with Raspberry Pi over Bluetooth to translate 3-DoF hand motion into real time HID commands via Python.
Implemented a custom motion detection algorithm using differential thresholding; resolved sensor jitter through software calibration and resolution tuning.

experience.title: Python Developer Intern
bullets: Developed a Python GUI using PyQt and Matplotlib for real time data acquisition and experimental visualization in a laboratory environment.
Used GitLab for version control and JupyterHub for collaborative data analysis and technical documentation.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Built a vision guided robotic pick and place system on Jetson and Arduino, integrating TensorRT optimized YOLO (5.2x speedup: 56.7 to 10.9 ms, 17.6 to 92 FPS vs eager PyTorch) for real time visual servoing.
Integrated dual VL53L0X ToF depth sensors via I2C mux for camera range gating and contact aware grasping, achieving 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end to end latency.
Implemented two link inverse kinematics in C++ on the embedded controller, driving five servos with range gated contact detection.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Deployed YOLOv8 on NVIDIA Jetson to detect and track objects, driving multi servo PWM control over UART with ToF range sensing.

projects.name: CUDA Kernel Optimization for VGG16 Inference
bullets: Replaced TorchScript convolution layers with custom CUDA C++ kernels using memory coalescing and constant memory, achieving 49.2ms vs 77.5ms CPU baseline (~35% speedup) with identical accuracy.
